digest.component_or_area: plan-review criteria routing and coaching moves overlay
propositions: A new project-only criterion project.symbol-reference-completeness with a coaching move should direct agents to re-derive source references using Serena's symbol tools when a plan's file/call-site inventory was hand-enumerated or incomplete.
The move text must include the string-literal sweep (monkeypatch.setattr/getattr/importlib) that the LSP cannot resolve, so coaching is complete.
The criterion must route to plan_review only because a project.* id can never enter code-review's closed applies_when vocabulary and would produce a permanently dead move.
The criterion must be advisory via default_posture 'advisory' and carry no blocking_enabled key, which is a code-review-only convention that plan-review's threshold_for never reads.
Code-review coaching moves are already overlay-driven via load_move_registry reading .rebar/code_review_moves.json, so no engine wiring is needed.
The change must ride the .rebar/ overlay only, leaving shipped default criteria under src/rebar/ unchanged for other clients.
